query:
SELECT dp.attendeeId, dp.firstName, dp.lastName, dp.company,
  GROUP_CONCAT(m.timeSlot ORDER BY m.timeSlot) as bookedSlots,
  COUNT(m.id) as meetingCount
FROM delegateProfiles dp
INNER JOIN meetings m ON m.attendeeId = dp.attendeeId AND m.status IN ('confirmed','suggested')
GROUP BY dp.attendeeId, dp.firstName, dp.lastName, dp.company
HAVING meetingCount > 0
ORDER BY dp.lastName
LIMIT 20 OFFSET 20;
